text_block_list.text:
Having regained her true form, Super Creek 
smiled, saying she was able to run with a 
clear heart.

Although she couldn't secure victory in 
the Kikuka Sho, she learned a great deal 
through the Classic races.

And so, having broken away from the 
Classics, her sights were set on her next 
race... the Arima Kinen, held at Nakayama 
Racecourse in winter!
